coinbase_convert_execute.rationale: Executes a quoted currency conversion, moving funds between assets.

coinbase_convert_get.rationale: Pass-through (read): status of a conversion by quote ID.

coinbase_convert_quote.rationale: Pass-through (precursor): a non-binding quote. An agent can obtain one itself, so it is not a control; coinbase_convert_execute is the governed step.

coinbase_env.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): shows the active and configured environments. The write path coinbase_set_env is governed.

coinbase_orders_cancel.rationale: Cancels open orders. Not a harmless undo — removing a resting stop-loss leaves a position unprotected.

coinbase_orders_close_position.rationale: Places a market order to flatten a position, realising gains or losses immediately.

coinbase_orders_create.rationale: Places a live order that executes immediately and moves funds.

coinbase_orders_edit.rationale: Changes an open order's price or size in place, altering committed exposure.

coinbase_orders_get.rationale: Pass-through (read): one order's status and fills.

coinbase_orders_preview.rationale: Pass-through (precursor): a POST that its own description says estimates fees, fill price, and slippage without executing. The HTTP verb is not the classifier.

coinbase_portfolios_create.rationale: Creates a new portfolio for segregating funds and positions.

coinbase_portfolios_delete.rationale: Permanently deletes a portfolio. The API requires it to be empty first, so no funds are at risk.

coinbase_portfolios_edit.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): a metadata-only rename that does not affect balances or positions, per its own description.

coinbase_products_best_bid_ask.rationale: Pass-through (read-public): best bid and ask. Public market data.

coinbase_products_book.rationale: Pass-through (read-public): order book. Public market data.

coinbase_products_candles.rationale: Pass-through (read-public): historical OHLCV. Public market data.

coinbase_products_get.rationale: Pass-through (read-public): product detail. Public market data.

coinbase_products_list.rationale: Pass-through (read-public): tradable products. Public market data.

coinbase_products_ticker.rationale: Pass-through (read-public): recent trades and best quote. Public market data.

coinbase_set_env.rationale: Re-targeting. Switches the active environment, so an order approved for sandbox can execute against real funds.

coinbase_template.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): example request body for a command.

coinbase_transfer.rationale: Moves funds between portfolios. Executes immediately.
